entries.meaningZh: 吸引并使人投入活动
entries.en: The museum uses simple puzzles to engage its youngest visitors.
entries.zh: 这家博物馆用简单的谜题吸引年龄最小的参观者参与其中。

entries.meaningZh: 用咖啡豆制成的饮品
entries.en: A cup of coffee warmed my hands at the windy station.
entries.zh: 在风很大的车站，一杯咖啡暖着我的双手。

entries.meaningZh: 涉及专门技术知识的
entries.en: The manual explains technical terms with clear drawings and everyday comparisons.
entries.zh: 这本手册用清晰的图画和日常生活中的类比解释技术术语。

entries.meaningZh: 由机构制定的正式规定
entries.en: A new regulation requires every fishing boat to carry emergency equipment.
entries.zh: 一项新规定要求每艘渔船都携带应急设备。

entries.meaningZh: 原本就生长在当地的
entries.en: Volunteers planted native trees along the creek to provide shelter for birds.
entries.zh: 志愿者沿小溪种下本地树种，为鸟类提供栖息处。

entries.meaningZh: 按劳动获得的报酬
entries.en: The bakery offered a higher wage to experienced night workers.
entries.zh: 这家面包店给有经验的夜班工人提供了更高的工资。

entries.meaningZh: 通过学习或经历逐渐掌握
entries.en: Children acquire new vocabulary while explaining their games to each other.
entries.zh: 孩子们在互相解释游戏玩法时学会新词汇。

entries.meaningZh: 理解或看待事情的角度
entries.en: Working behind the counter gave me a different perspective on the business.
entries.zh: 在柜台后工作让我从不同角度认识了这门生意。

entries.meaningZh: 一次进食所吃的饭菜
entries.en: We shared a simple meal before setting off on the overnight train.
entries.zh: 乘夜间火车出发前，我们一起吃了顿简单的饭。

entries.meaningZh: 理解和解决问题的能力
entries.en: The dog's intelligence surprised us when it opened the garden gate.
entries.zh: 那只狗打开花园门时，它的聪明才智让我们吃了一惊。

entries.meaningZh: 穿在脚上用于保护的鞋子
entries.en: A small stone inside my shoe made every step uncomfortable.
entries.zh: 鞋里的一颗小石子让我每走一步都不舒服。

entries.meaningZh: 道路上行驶的车辆
entries.en: Morning traffic moved slowly past the roadworks outside our apartment.
entries.zh: 早晨的车流缓慢地经过我们公寓外的道路施工区。

entries.meaningZh: 集中展出作品或物品的活动
entries.en: Her first exhibition filled a tiny gallery with enormous paper flowers.
entries.zh: 她的首次展览让一间小画廊里开满了巨大的纸花。

entries.meaningZh: 一张薄而平的纸
entries.en: Fold this sheet of paper twice, then cut along the crease.
entries.zh: 把这张纸折两次，然后沿着折痕剪开。

entries.meaningZh: 某人或某物所在的地点
entries.en: The invitation includes a map showing the exact location of the farm.
entries.zh: 请柬附有一张标明农场确切位置的地图。

entries.meaningZh: 对成年男子的礼貌称呼
entries.en: The elderly gentleman by the window offered us his spare chairs.
entries.zh: 窗边的那位老先生把他多余的椅子让给了我们。

entries.meaningZh: 将物品分发给多人的过程
entries.en: Rain delayed the distribution of food parcels to the mountain villages.
entries.zh: 降雨耽误了向山村分发食品包裹。

entries.meaningZh: 使人记得要做某事
entries.en: Please remind me to return the library books after lunch.
entries.zh: 请提醒我午饭后归还图书馆的书。

entries.meaningZh: 涉及行为对错和是非的
entries.en: The story raises a moral question about keeping another person's secret.
entries.zh: 这个故事提出了一个有关替他人保守秘密的道德问题。

entries.meaningZh: 继续拥有而不失去
entries.en: The renovated cinema will retain its original ceiling and wooden ticket booth.
entries.zh: 翻修后的电影院将保留原来的天花板和木制售票亭。

entries.meaningZh: 用于解锁或验证的秘密字符组合
entries.en: Enter the six-digit code printed on the back of your ticket.
entries.zh: 输入印在你门票背面的六位数字密码。

entries.meaningZh: 用来治疗疾病的药物
entries.en: Grandpa keeps his medicine in a labelled box beside the kettle.
entries.zh: 爷爷把药放在水壶旁一个贴有标签的盒子里。

entries.meaningZh: 没有能力或条件去做的
entries.en: With both hands full, I was unable to reach my keys.
entries.zh: 由于双手都拿着东西，我没法拿到钥匙。

entries.meaningZh: 迅速伸手抓住或拿起
entries.en: Please grab the loose rope before the boat drifts away from the dock.
entries.zh: 请在船漂离码头之前抓住那根松开的绳子。

entries.meaningZh: 加入并参与某项活动
entries.en: You can participate in the workshop without bringing any sewing equipment.
entries.zh: 你不需要带任何缝纫工具就能参加这个工作坊。

entries.meaningZh: 大腿与小腿相连的关节
entries.en: He rested one knee on the cushion while tying his boot.
entries.zh: 他系靴子时把一侧膝盖放在垫子上。

entries.meaningZh: 退休后定期领取的生活收入
entries.en: Her monthly pension covers the rent on a small seaside flat.
entries.zh: 她每月的退休金够支付一套海边小公寓的房租。

entries.meaningZh: 在影视或戏剧中扮演角色的人
entries.en: The actor changed his voice completely when he played the king.
entries.zh: 那位演员扮演国王时完全改变了自己的声音。

entries.meaningZh: 随条件不同而发生变化
entries.en: Delivery times vary depending on how far you live from the warehouse.
entries.zh: 送货时间会根据你家离仓库的距离而有所不同。

entries.meaningZh: 可供挑选的一组物品
entries.en: The corner shop has a surprising selection of locally made cheeses.
entries.zh: 这家街角小店出售的本地奶酪种类多得令人意外。

entries.meaningZh: 用于表达很有把握的判断
entries.en: With so many dark clouds overhead, surely we should move the picnic indoors.
entries.zh: 头顶上有这么多乌云，我们当然该把野餐移到室内。

entries.meaningZh: 可加工成各种形状的人造材料
entries.en: The sculpture looks like glass, but it is actually made of plastic.
entries.zh: 这座雕塑看起来像玻璃，实际上却是塑料做的。

entries.meaningZh: 从底部到顶部距离很大的
entries.en: A tall sunflower leaned over the fence into our neighbour's garden.
entries.zh: 一株高高的向日葵越过篱笆，倾向邻居的花园。

entries.meaningZh: 用于连接形成对比的情况
entries.en: My brother likes crowded markets, whereas I prefer quiet walks beside the river.
entries.zh: 我弟弟喜欢拥挤的集市，而我更喜欢沿河安静地散步。

entries.meaningZh: 说明一个词或概念含义的表述
entries.en: Could you give a simpler definition of this word for younger readers?
entries.zh: 你能给年轻读者用更简单的话解释这个词的含义吗？

entries.meaningZh: 数量或程度相当大的
entries.en: Repairing the roof will require a substantial amount of money.
entries.zh: 修理屋顶需要一笔数目不小的钱。

entries.meaningZh: 供食用的鸡肉
entries.en: The kitchen smelled of roast chicken, garlic, and freshly baked bread.
entries.zh: 厨房里飘着烤鸡、大蒜和刚出炉面包的香味。

entries.meaningZh: 符合某种用途或需要的
entries.en: These waterproof boots are suitable for walking across wet grass.
entries.zh: 这双防水靴适合穿着走过潮湿的草地。

entries.meaningZh: 小说诗歌等具有艺术性的文字作品
entries.en: Our literature class compares stories written in different countries during the same decade.
entries.zh: 我们的文学课比较同一个十年里不同国家创作的故事。

entries.meaningZh: 违反法律的行为
entries.en: The judge described selling stolen bicycles as a serious offence.
entries.zh: 法官称出售偷来的自行车是一种严重的违法行为。

entries.meaningZh: 数量或程度的下降
entries.en: Better insulation brought a noticeable reduction in the building's heating costs.
entries.zh: 更好的隔热措施使这栋楼的取暖费用明显下降。

entries.meaningZh: 植物枝干上通常呈绿色的薄片部分
entries.en: A single red leaf floated through the open window onto my desk.
entries.zh: 一片红叶从敞开的窗户飘进来，落在我的书桌上。

entries.meaningZh: 将注意力持续放在一件事上
entries.en: The ticking clock disturbed her concentration during the final puzzle.
entries.zh: 做最后一道谜题时，钟表的滴答声使她分了心。

entries.meaningZh: 供游泳使用的水池
entries.en: The children splashed in the pool while their parents sat nearby.
entries.zh: 孩子们在游泳池里嬉水，父母坐在附近。

entries.meaningZh: 从事经营活动的企业
entries.en: What began as a kitchen project became a successful family enterprise.
entries.zh: 最初在厨房里开展的小项目后来成了一家成功的家族企业。

entries.meaningZh: 用于调味的咸味晶体
entries.en: Add a pinch of salt after tasting the finished soup.
entries.zh: 尝过煮好的汤后，再加一小撮盐。

entries.meaningZh: 通常坚硬且能导电导热的材料
entries.en: The old gate was made of metal and covered in rust.
entries.zh: 那扇旧大门是金属做的，表面满是铁锈。

entries.meaningZh: 与公司或公司整体有关的
entries.en: She left corporate life to run a bookshop in her hometown.
entries.zh: 她告别公司里的职业生活，回到家乡经营一家书店。

entries.meaningZh: 数量上能够满足需要的
entries.en: One small suitcase provides sufficient space for my weekend clothes.
entries.zh: 一个小行李箱就有足够空间装我周末要穿的衣服。

entries.meaningZh: 属于城市或与城市有关的
entries.en: Rooftop gardens give urban residents a chance to grow their own food.
entries.zh: 屋顶花园让城市居民有机会自己种植食物。

entries.meaningZh: 用很大的声音说或呼喊
entries.en: There is no need to shout; I can hear you clearly.
entries.zh: 不用喊，我能清楚地听见你说话。

entries.meaningZh: 用于给食物增加甜味的物质
entries.en: The recipe uses honey instead of sugar to sweeten the biscuits.
entries.zh: 这个食谱用蜂蜜代替糖来给饼干增加甜味。

entries.meaningZh: 围绕恒星运行的大型天体
entries.en: Through the telescope, the planet appeared as a tiny blue dot.
entries.zh: 透过望远镜，那颗行星看起来像一个小蓝点。

entries.meaningZh: 将零件装到一起的过程
entries.en: The assembly of the desk took longer than carrying it upstairs.
entries.zh: 组装这张书桌花的时间比把它搬上楼还长。

entries.meaningZh: 与自己敌对的人或一方
entries.en: The former rivals joined forces when they faced a common enemy.
entries.zh: 昔日的对手在面对共同敌人时联手了。

entries.meaningZh: 能与碱反应的一类化学物质
entries.en: The students wore goggles before adding acid to the test tube.
entries.zh: 学生们在往试管里加酸之前戴上了护目镜。

entries.meaningZh: 参加体育训练和比赛的人
entries.en: The young athlete practised her starts long after the others had left.
entries.zh: 其他人离开很久后，那位年轻运动员仍在练习起跑。

entries.meaningZh: 人的内在精神和心灵
entries.en: Painting gave her tired soul a quiet place to rest.
entries.zh: 绘画给她疲惫的心灵提供了一处安静的休憩之所。

entries.meaningZh: 共同讨论或评判问题的一组人
entries.en: A panel of local artists will choose the winning poster.
entries.zh: 一个由当地艺术家组成的评审组将选出获胜的海报。

entries.meaningZh: 在另一件事发生的同时
entries.en: I watered the balcony plants whilst my sister prepared breakfast.
entries.zh: 姐姐准备早餐时，我给阳台上的植物浇了水。

entries.meaningZh: 令人愉快满足的感受
entries.en: She took great pleasure in teaching her grandson to ride a bicycle.
entries.zh: 教孙子骑自行车给她带来了很大的乐趣。

entries.meaningZh: 提前判断某事将会发生
entries.en: Even experienced sailors cannot predict every sudden change in the wind.
entries.zh: 即使是经验丰富的水手，也无法预料风的每一次突然变化。

entries.meaningZh: 从多个选项中挑出
entries.en: Please select three photographs that tell the story of your summer.
entries.zh: 请选择三张能讲述你暑假经历的照片。

entries.meaningZh: 流露或引发强烈感情的
entries.en: Her farewell speech was so emotional that several colleagues began to cry.
entries.zh: 她的告别演讲如此动情，几位同事都哭了起来。

entries.meaningZh: 表示冷热程度的数值
entries.en: The outdoor temperature fell sharply as soon as the sun disappeared.
entries.zh: 太阳一消失，室外温度就急剧下降。

entries.meaningZh: 处在某人或某物旁边
entries.en: Leave your muddy boots beside the door before coming inside.
entries.zh: 进屋之前，把沾满泥的靴子放在门旁。

entries.meaningZh: 提供法律咨询并处理法律事务的律师
entries.en: Their solicitor checked the house contract before they signed it.
entries.zh: 他们的律师在他们签字前检查了购房合同。

entries.meaningZh: 话语中没有直接说出的意思
entries.en: The implication of her remark was that someone had hidden the letter.
entries.zh: 她那句话暗示有人把信藏了起来。

entries.meaningZh: 对成就或贡献的肯定
entries.en: The award gave the volunteers recognition for years of patient work.
entries.zh: 这个奖项肯定了志愿者们多年来耐心付出的工作。

entries.meaningZh: 组成整体的一个部分
entries.en: A damaged component inside the pump caused the entire system to stop.
entries.zh: 水泵内部一个部件损坏，导致整个系统停止运行。

entries.meaningZh: 以认真而郑重的态度
entries.en: Please take this warning seriously when you approach the cliff edge.
entries.zh: 接近悬崖边缘时，请认真对待这条警告。

entries.meaningZh: 在部分程度上
entries.en: The path was partly hidden by leaves after last night's storm.
entries.zh: 昨夜的暴风雨过后，小路有一部分被树叶盖住了。

entries.meaningZh: 在另一个地方
entries.en: This café is full, so we will have to eat elsewhere.
entries.zh: 这家咖啡馆客满了，所以我们得去别处吃饭。

entries.meaningZh: 必定如此而无其他可能
entries.en: A higher price does not necessarily mean a product will last longer.
entries.zh: 价格更高并不一定意味着产品更耐用。

entries.meaningZh: 以说不清的某种方式
entries.en: The cat somehow squeezed through a gap narrower than its head.
entries.zh: 不知怎么，那只猫竟从一条比它脑袋还窄的缝隙挤了过去。

entries.meaningZh: 在法庭上根据证据作出裁决的陪审团
entries.en: The jury listened carefully as the witness described the missing car.
entries.zh: 证人描述失踪的汽车时，陪审团仔细地听着。

entries.meaningZh: 照护病人并协助治疗的专业人员
entries.en: A nurse showed the little boy how the hospital bed moved.
entries.zh: 一位护士向小男孩演示病床是怎样移动的。

entries.meaningZh: 鸟类身体前面的胸部
entries.en: The little bird had a bright orange breast and dark wings.
entries.zh: 那只小鸟有着鲜橙色的胸部和深色的翅膀。

entries.meaningZh: 没有声音的安静状态
entries.en: After the orchestra finished, a brief silence filled the concert hall.
entries.zh: 管弦乐队演奏结束后，音乐厅里出现了短暂的寂静。

entries.meaningZh: 接受并承认某个事实
entries.en: We must acknowledge our mistakes before we can improve the service.
entries.zh: 我们必须先承认错误，才能改进服务。

entries.meaningZh: 作品或讨论围绕的主要思想
entries.en: Friendship is the central theme of her latest illustrated story.
entries.zh: 友谊是她最新那本插画故事的核心主题。

entries.meaningZh: 将作品印制或公开发行的过程
entries.en: The poet revised the final verse shortly before publication of the collection.
entries.zh: 那位诗人在诗集出版前不久修改了最后一节诗。

entries.meaningZh: 呈现柠檬或向日葵般颜色的
entries.en: A yellow umbrella stood out among the dark coats on the platform.
entries.zh: 站台上的深色外套之间，一把黄色雨伞格外醒目。

entries.meaningZh: 令人分心或不悦的声音
entries.en: The noise from the upstairs renovation made our afternoon meeting difficult.
entries.zh: 楼上装修的噪声让我们下午的会议难以进行。

entries.meaningZh: 通过例子或图像把事情解释清楚
entries.en: These photographs illustrate how the shoreline has changed over fifty years.
entries.zh: 这些照片展示了海岸线在五十年间发生的变化。

entries.meaningZh: 轮班工作的一段时间
entries.en: My evening shift ends just before the last bus leaves.
entries.zh: 我的晚班恰好在末班公交车出发前结束。

entries.meaningZh: 经营活动带来的收入
entries.en: Ticket sales provide most of the theatre's annual revenue.
entries.zh: 售票为这家剧院提供了年度收入的大部分。

entries.meaningZh: 发展过程中的一个阶段
entries.en: The next phase of construction includes a playground and a footbridge.
entries.zh: 下一阶段的建设包括一个游乐场和一座人行桥。

entries.meaningZh: 无需他人要求便主动行动的能力
entries.en: Maya showed initiative by organising a welcome lunch for the new staff.
entries.zh: 玛雅主动为新员工组织欢迎午餐，表现出了主动精神。

entries.meaningZh: 从最基本的情况来说
entries.en: The two machines work basically the same way despite their different shapes.
entries.zh: 尽管外形不同，这两台机器的运作方式基本相同。

entries.meaningZh: 尚未证实却暂且接受的想法
entries.en: Our plan rested on the assumption that the bridge would reopen Monday.
entries.zh: 我们的计划以大桥将在周一重新开放这一假设为基础。

entries.meaningZh: 逐渐形成的一般变化方向
entries.en: The survey reveals a growing trend towards repairing old furniture.
entries.zh: 这项调查显示，修复旧家具的趋势正在增强。

entries.meaningZh: 在船舶飞机等上共同工作的全体人员
entries.en: The ship's crew checked the ropes before leaving the harbour.
entries.zh: 船员们在离港前检查了绳索。

entries.meaningZh: 通过收缩使身体活动的组织
entries.en: She felt a muscle in her shoulder tighten while lifting the box.
entries.zh: 搬箱子时，她感到肩膀上的一块肌肉绷紧了。

entries.meaningZh: 陈列和展示艺术作品的场所
entries.en: The gallery stayed open late for the opening of the sculpture exhibition.
entries.zh: 为举行雕塑展的开幕活动，这家画廊延长了营业时间。

entries.meaningZh: 对某件事的想法或认识
entries.en: His first camping trip changed his notion of a comfortable holiday.
entries.zh: 第一次露营改变了他对舒适假期的认识。

entries.meaningZh: 用照片影像等记录下来
entries.en: Try to capture the reflections before the wind disturbs the water.
entries.zh: 试着在风吹皱水面之前拍下这些倒影。

entries.meaningZh: 身体颈部与腹部之间的前侧部位
entries.en: He held the sleeping kitten gently against his chest.
entries.zh: 他把熟睡的小猫轻轻抱在胸前。

entries.meaningZh: 给予某事特别的重视
entries.en: The course places equal emphasis on practical skills and careful observation.
entries.zh: 这门课同样重视实践技能和仔细观察。

entries.meaningZh: 确实如此而非表面上如此
entries.en: Only after climbing the tower did I truly understand the town's layout.
entries.zh: 直到登上塔楼，我才真正了解这座小镇的布局。

entries.meaningZh: 具有其他事物没有的特点的
entries.en: Each handmade bowl has a unique pattern beneath its blue glaze.
entries.zh: 每只手工碗的蓝色釉面下都有独特的图案。

entries.meaningZh: 与共同文化血缘等形成的族群有关的
entries.en: The festival celebrates the music of several ethnic communities in the city.
entries.zh: 这个节日庆祝城里几个族群各自的音乐文化。

entries.meaningZh: 需要先于其他事情处理的事
entries.en: Finding clean drinking water became our first priority after the storm.
entries.zh: 暴风雨过后，找到干净的饮用水成了我们的首要任务。

entries.meaningZh: 不同事物搭配在一起的组合
entries.en: The combination of lemon and fresh mint made the drink refreshing.
entries.zh: 柠檬与新鲜薄荷的搭配让这杯饮料十分清爽。

entries.meaningZh: 依靠某人或某物提供帮助
entries.en: Many island residents rely on the ferry to reach the mainland.
entries.zh: 许多岛上居民依靠渡轮前往大陆。

entries.meaningZh: 对别人的帮助心怀感谢
entries.en: I appreciate the time you spent explaining those confusing instructions.
entries.zh: 我很感谢你花时间解释那些令人困惑的说明。

entries.meaningZh: 位置在另一部分之上的
entries.en: Keep the fragile glasses on the upper shelf, beyond the children's reach.
entries.zh: 把易碎的玻璃杯放在上层架子上，让孩子够不着。

entries.meaningZh: 事情进行后产生的最终结果
entries.en: Neither team could predict the outcome until the final seconds.
entries.zh: 直到最后几秒，两队都无法预料比赛结果。

entries.meaningZh: 道路上供一列车辆行驶的车道
entries.en: A broken truck blocked the left lane near the tunnel entrance.
entries.zh: 一辆故障卡车堵住了隧道入口附近的左侧车道。

entries.meaningZh: 表面沾有血的
entries.en: He wrapped his bloody finger in a clean cloth after the cut.
entries.zh: 手指划伤后，他用一块干净的布包住了沾血的手指。

entries.meaningZh: 为特定用途划定的区域
entries.en: Cars are not allowed inside the pedestrian zone around the square.
entries.zh: 广场周围的步行区内禁止汽车通行。

entries.meaningZh: 从睡眠中醒过来
entries.en: I usually wake before sunrise when we stay at the farm.
entries.zh: 我们住在农场时，我通常在日出前就醒了。

entries.meaningZh: 过去用于居住和防御的大型城堡
entries.en: The ruined castle overlooks a narrow bridge and a winding river.
entries.zh: 那座城堡遗址俯瞰着一座窄桥和一条蜿蜒的河流。

entries.meaningZh: 指我们本人作为动作的承受者
entries.en: We taught ourselves to repair bicycles by taking apart an old one.
entries.zh: 我们拆开一辆旧自行车，自学了修理自行车。

entries.meaningZh: 加入团体后拥有的成员资格
entries.en: Your library membership includes access to several online newspaper collections.
entries.zh: 你的图书馆会员资格包括使用几个在线报纸资料库的权限。

entries.meaningZh: 穿在上身且通常有领有袖的衣服
entries.en: He chose a plain white shirt for his first day at work.
entries.zh: 上班第一天，他选了一件素白衬衫。

entries.meaningZh: 驾驶飞机的人
entries.en: The pilot circled the airport while waiting for permission to land.
entries.zh: 飞行员在机场上空盘旋，等待降落许可。

entries.meaningZh: 经过一段过程后最终
entries.en: Several routes looked promising, but we ultimately chose the coastal path.
entries.zh: 几条路线看起来都不错，但我们最终选了沿海小路。

entries.meaningZh: 供他人考虑采纳的主意
entries.en: Her suggestion of moving the meeting outdoors received an enthusiastic response.
entries.zh: 她提出把会议移到室外的建议，得到了热烈响应。

entries.meaningZh: 令人感兴趣或愿意选择的
entries.en: Flexible hours make this position attractive to parents with young children.
entries.zh: 灵活的工作时间让这个职位对有年幼孩子的父母很有吸引力。

entries.meaningZh: 从空中降落的白色冰晶
entries.en: Fresh snow covered the footprints we had left beside the cabin.
entries.zh: 新下的雪盖住了我们留在小屋旁的脚印。

entries.meaningZh: 未经允许拿走他人财物
entries.en: Someone tried to steal my bicycle while I was buying bread.
entries.zh: 我买面包时，有人试图偷走我的自行车。

entries.meaningZh: 为了实现目标而持续努力
entries.en: She moved closer to the coast to pursue a career in marine biology.
entries.zh: 为了从事海洋生物学工作，她搬到了离海岸更近的地方。

entries.meaningZh: 以一百为基数表示的比例
entries.en: A small percentage of the tickets is reserved for local students.
entries.zh: 一小部分门票预留给了当地学生。

entries.meaningZh: 用作食物的动物肉
entries.en: The restaurant serves grilled meat with seasonal vegetables and warm bread.
entries.zh: 这家餐厅供应烤肉，配以时令蔬菜和热面包。

entries.meaningZh: 植物扎根生长的地表土层
entries.en: Loosen the soil around each seedling before watering it gently.
entries.zh: 轻轻浇水之前，先把每株幼苗周围的土松一松。

entries.meaningZh: 列出主题及其所在页码的索引
entries.en: Check the index at the back to find the chapter on bees.
entries.zh: 查看书后的索引，找到讲蜜蜂的那一章。

entries.meaningZh: 通过手术治疗身体问题
entries.en: Her injured shoulder required surgery before she could return to swimming.
entries.zh: 她受伤的肩膀需要接受手术，之后才能恢复游泳。

entries.meaningZh: 两侧山地之间较低的地带
entries.en: Thin morning mist drifted through the valley below our campsite.
entries.zh: 清晨的薄雾飘过我们营地下方的山谷。

entries.meaningZh: 将球击入场地洞中的体育运动
entries.en: My uncle plays golf on Sunday mornings with his former neighbours.
entries.zh: 我叔叔每周日早晨和以前的邻居一起打高尔夫球。

entries.meaningZh: 不合常理而十分冒险的
entries.en: Crossing that flooded road would be a crazy thing to do.
entries.zh: 穿过那条被水淹的路是非常冒险的做法。

entries.meaningZh: 对成功或生存极为重要的
entries.en: Accurate maps are vital when rescue teams search unfamiliar mountain paths.
entries.zh: 救援队搜寻陌生山路时，准确的地图至关重要。

entries.meaningZh: 在受伤或生病后恢复健康
entries.en: The injured owl will recover in a quiet room at the sanctuary.
entries.zh: 那只受伤的猫头鹰将在救护中心一间安静的屋子里康复。

entries.meaningZh: 由多个环相扣连接成的链条
entries.en: The bicycle chain slipped off as I climbed the steep hill.
entries.zh: 我骑车爬陡坡时，自行车链条掉了。

entries.meaningZh: 对某个领域有深入知识的专家
entries.en: The museum invited a textile specialist to examine the faded silk banner.
entries.zh: 博物馆邀请了一位纺织品专家检查那面褪色的丝绸旗帜。

entries.meaningZh: 使人或物具有辨识度的特点
entries.en: One distinctive characteristic of this bird is its unusually curved beak.
entries.zh: 这种鸟的一个显著特点是它异常弯曲的喙。

entries.meaningZh: 运用科学设计建造设施或机器的学科
entries.en: Her interest in bridges led her to study engineering at university.
entries.zh: 对桥梁的兴趣促使她在大学学习工程学。

entries.meaningZh: 呈现金子般颜色的
entries.en: The setting sun cast a golden light across the empty wheat field.
entries.zh: 落日把金色的光洒在空旷的麦田上。

entries.meaningZh: 找到问题的答案或处理办法
entries.en: We used the old photographs to solve the mystery of the missing doorway.
entries.zh: 我们利用旧照片解开了那处门口为何消失的谜团。

entries.meaningZh: 某片区域整体呈现的自然景色
entries.en: The rocky landscape gradually gave way to green fields and scattered villages.
entries.zh: 满是岩石的景观逐渐变成了绿色田野和零星村庄。

entries.meaningZh: 从某处向外出来
entries.en: Water burst forth from the cracked pipe beneath the sink.
entries.zh: 水从水槽下方裂开的管道中喷涌而出。

entries.meaningZh: 体现某一类事物常见特点的
entries.en: A typical day at the shelter begins with feeding the animals.
entries.zh: 收容所里平常的一天从给动物喂食开始。

entries.meaningZh: 将不需要的事物彻底去除
entries.en: Clear labels help eliminate confusion when several people share a kitchen.
entries.zh: 几个人共用厨房时，清楚的标签有助于消除混淆。

entries.meaningZh: 覆盖地球大片区域的咸水水体
entries.en: From the cliff, the ocean stretched as far as we could see.
entries.zh: 从悬崖上望去，海洋一望无际。

entries.meaningZh: 接触某人某物后形成的感受或判断
entries.en: His patient answers left a good impression on the visiting students.
entries.zh: 他耐心的回答给来访学生留下了良好的印象。

entries.meaningZh: 住在自己家附近的人
entries.en: Our neighbour watered the tomatoes while we were away visiting family.
entries.zh: 我们外出探亲时，邻居帮忙给番茄浇了水。

entries.meaningZh: 掌握一个国家统治权的政府
entries.en: The new regime promised elections after years of strict military rule.
entries.zh: 经历多年的严格军事统治后，新政权承诺举行选举。

entries.meaningZh: 能映出人或物影像的光滑表面
entries.en: She adjusted the hallway mirror so the children could see themselves.
entries.zh: 她调整了走廊里的镜子，让孩子们能照见自己。

entries.meaningZh: 一个地方给人的整体情绪感受
entries.en: Soft lighting and quiet music created a relaxed atmosphere in the café.
entries.zh: 柔和的灯光和轻声播放的音乐营造了咖啡馆里轻松的氛围。

entries.meaningZh: 体现明智判断的
entries.en: It was smart to photograph the wiring before disconnecting the old lamp.
entries.zh: 拆下旧灯的线路前先拍照，是个明智的做法。

entries.meaningZh: 对既有制度或做法的重大变革
entries.en: Cheap printing brought a revolution in how ordinary people shared ideas.
entries.zh: 低成本印刷使普通人交流思想的方式发生了重大变革。

entries.meaningZh: 机器内部共同完成动作的零件系统
entries.en: Dust had jammed the mechanism that raises the window blind.
entries.zh: 灰尘卡住了用于升起百叶窗的机械装置。

entries.meaningZh: 储存液体或气体的大容器
entries.en: Rainwater flows from the roof into a large underground tank.
entries.zh: 雨水从屋顶流入一个大型地下储水罐。

entries.meaningZh: 媒体对某事件的报道
entries.en: The local paper gave extensive coverage to the community theatre festival.
entries.zh: 当地报纸对社区戏剧节进行了大量报道。

entries.meaningZh: 常用于制造钢材的金属元素
entries.en: The old iron fence felt cold under my bare hands.
entries.zh: 我赤手摸着那道旧铁栅栏，感到一阵冰凉。

entries.meaningZh: 受雇在他人家中提供劳务的人
entries.en: In the novel, a servant carries letters between the two households.
entries.zh: 小说中，一名仆人在两户人家之间传递信件。

entries.meaningZh: 在任何一个地方
entries.en: You can sit anywhere except the seats marked for the musicians.
entries.zh: 除了标明留给乐手的座位，你可以坐在任何地方。

entries.meaningZh: 牛等哺乳动物分泌的白色乳汁
entries.en: He poured cold milk over the cereal and sliced bananas.
entries.zh: 他把冷牛奶倒在麦片和香蕉片上。

entries.meaningZh: 人或动物的健康幸福状况
entries.en: The shelter puts the welfare of its animals before visitor convenience.
entries.zh: 这家收容所把动物的福祉放在访客的便利之前。

entries.meaningZh: 在某物的正下方
entries.en: We found a dry patch beneath the bridge during the sudden shower.
entries.zh: 突遇阵雨时，我们在桥下找到了一块干燥的地方。

entries.meaningZh: 对未来将发生之事的预期
entries.en: She arrived early in the expectation that parking would be difficult.
entries.zh: 她预料停车会很困难，因此提前到了。

entries.meaningZh: 在一定程度上但不很强烈
entries.en: The room looked somewhat larger after we removed the heavy curtains.
entries.zh: 拆掉厚重的窗帘后，房间看起来大了一些。

entries.meaningZh: 某事物最初出现的来源
entries.en: No one in the village remembers the origin of this unusual custom.
entries.zh: 村里没人记得这种奇特习俗的起源。

entries.meaningZh: 海边由沙或小石子形成的岸地
entries.en: We reached the beach just as the first surfers entered the water.
entries.zh: 我们到达海滩时，第一批冲浪者正好下水。

entries.meaningZh: 与某人一起前往某处
entries.en: A local guide will accompany the visitors on their walk through the forest.
entries.zh: 一位当地向导将陪同游客步行穿过森林。

entries.meaningZh: 通常由谷物发酵制成的酒
entries.en: The adults ordered beer while the children chose sparkling apple juice.
entries.zh: 大人们点了啤酒，孩子们则选了气泡苹果汁。

entries.meaningZh: 创建组织或设施的过程
entries.en: The establishment of a village library gave children access to more books.
entries.zh: 村图书馆的建立让孩子们有了更多书可读。

entries.meaningZh: 用于引出令人遗憾的情况
entries.en: We reached the orchard, but unfortunately the last cherries had already been sold.
entries.zh: 我们到了果园，但遗憾的是，最后一批樱桃已经卖完了。

entries.meaningZh: 因勇敢行动而受到敬佩的人
entries.en: The firefighter became a local hero after rescuing the trapped schoolchildren.
entries.zh: 那位消防员救出被困的小学生后，成了当地的英雄。

entries.meaningZh: 为某项需要而花费的钱
entries.en: Replacing the broken freezer was an expense we had not planned for.
entries.zh: 更换坏掉的冰柜是我们没有预料到的一项开支。

entries.meaningZh: 用于增添辛辣味的胡椒粉
entries.en: A little black pepper gave the creamy potato soup extra warmth.
entries.zh: 少许黑胡椒给奶香土豆汤增添了一丝辛辣的暖意。

entries.meaningZh: 引用资料作为观点的依据
entries.en: Please cite the original study when you discuss these surprising results.
entries.zh: 讨论这些令人意外的结果时，请引用原始研究。

entries.meaningZh: 供人食用的植物或其部分
entries.en: Choose one green vegetable to serve alongside the rice tonight.
entries.zh: 选一种绿色蔬菜来搭配今晚的米饭。

entries.meaningZh: 按特定方式烹调的一道菜
entries.en: Her favourite dish combines roasted pumpkin with chickpeas and lemon dressing.
entries.zh: 她最喜欢的一道菜把烤南瓜、鹰嘴豆和柠檬酱汁搭配在一起。

entries.meaningZh: 君主等居住的宏大建筑
entries.en: Visitors crossed a wide courtyard before entering the old royal palace.
entries.zh: 游客穿过宽阔的庭院后，进入了那座古老的王宫。

entries.meaningZh: 范围或规模极大的
entries.en: A vast stretch of desert lay between the two remote towns.
entries.zh: 这两座偏远小镇之间隔着一大片沙漠。

entries.meaningZh: 在所有地方或许多地方
entries.en: After the parade, colourful paper scraps were scattered everywhere along the street.
entries.zh: 游行过后，街上到处散落着彩色纸屑。

entries.meaningZh: 表示反对并试图阻止
entries.en: Residents oppose the plan to replace the playground with a car park.
entries.zh: 居民们反对把游乐场改成停车场的计划。

entries.meaningZh: 属于当今时代的
entries.en: The museum pairs ancient pottery with contemporary paintings in the same room.
entries.zh: 博物馆把古代陶器与当代绘画搭配陈列在同一展厅。

entries.meaningZh: 人们普遍遵守的惯常做法
entries.en: By convention, the host speaks first at the annual dinner.
entries.zh: 按照惯例，主人在年度晚宴上首先致辞。

entries.meaningZh: 控制电路接通或断开的装置
entries.en: The light switch is hidden behind the coat beside the door.
entries.zh: 电灯开关被门旁的外套挡住了。

entries.meaningZh: 明确针对某个特定对象或目的
entries.en: These gloves were designed specifically for handling delicate museum objects.
entries.zh: 这副手套是专门为拿取精细的博物馆藏品设计的。

entries.meaningZh: 体力或精力消耗后需要休息的
entries.en: The tired hikers fell asleep before the soup had finished cooking.
entries.zh: 疲惫的徒步者们在汤还没煮好时就睡着了。

entries.meaningZh: 传达信息或指示的声音动作等
entries.en: A raised green flag was the signal to begin the race.
entries.zh: 举起的绿旗就是开始比赛的信号。

entries.meaningZh: 供人扶握或起围挡作用的横杆
entries.en: Hold the rail as you climb the narrow stairs to the deck.
entries.zh: 沿狭窄的楼梯登上甲板时，请扶住栏杆。

entries.meaningZh: 查看事物之间相同与不同之处
entries.en: A direct comparison shows that the newer lamp uses less electricity.
entries.zh: 直接比较可见，新款灯耗电更少。

entries.meaningZh: 通过人为方式终止妊娠
entries.en: The documentary includes a woman's account of her abortion.
entries.zh: 这部纪录片包含一位女性对自己终止妊娠经历的讲述。

entries.meaningZh: 亲眼看到某事件发生的人
entries.en: A witness remembered seeing a blue van outside the warehouse.
entries.zh: 一名目击者记得曾看到仓库外有一辆蓝色货车。

entries.meaningZh: 勉强达到某种程度
entries.en: The suitcase was so heavy that I could barely lift it.
entries.zh: 行李箱太重了，我勉强才能把它提起来。

entries.meaningZh: 突出说明某事的重要性
entries.en: The guide paused to emphasize the importance of staying on the marked trail.
entries.zh: 向导停下来，强调沿标记好的小径行走的重要性。

entries.meaningZh: 表示完全确定而毫无疑问
entries.en: That is definitely my scarf; I recognise the uneven stitches.
entries.zh: 那肯定是我的围巾，我认得那些不均匀的针脚。

entries.meaningZh: 在最初的时候
entries.en: This bright apartment was originally a storage room above the bakery.
entries.zh: 这间明亮的公寓最初是面包店楼上的储藏室。

entries.meaningZh: 投入资金以期获得回报
entries.en: The cooperative plans to invest its profits in a larger delivery van.
entries.zh: 这家合作社计划用利润投资购买一辆更大的送货车。

entries.meaningZh: 乘坐交通工具但不负责驾驶的人
entries.en: The last passenger boarded the bus carrying a basket of flowers.
entries.zh: 最后一位乘客提着一篮鲜花上了公交车。

entries.meaningZh: 用来传输电力或信号的绝缘线缆
entries.en: An orange cable connected the outdoor lights to the power supply.
entries.zh: 一根橙色电缆把室外灯连接到电源上。

entries.meaningZh: 使某物处于可能受影响的环境中
entries.en: Do not expose these old photographs to direct sunlight for long periods.
entries.zh: 不要让这些老照片长时间受到阳光直射。

entries.meaningZh: 建筑中直立承重或装饰的柱子
entries.en: A single stone column supports the small balcony above the entrance.
entries.zh: 一根石柱支撑着入口上方的小阳台。

entries.meaningZh: 帮助有需要者的非营利组织
entries.en: The charity collects warm coats for people without a permanent home.
entries.zh: 这家慈善机构为没有固定住所的人募集保暖外套。

entries.meaningZh: 从牛奶中取得的浓稠乳脂
entries.en: She poured a little cream over the warm apple pie.
entries.zh: 她在温热的苹果派上淋了一点奶油。

entries.meaningZh: 生产商品的公司或厂家
entries.en: The manufacturer replaced the faulty kettle after checking its serial number.
entries.zh: 厂家核对序列号后，更换了那只有故障的水壶。
